capabilities: List incoming [[>target]] and [[>target|display]] references from saved .fountain scripts to the active note
Show scene headings and nearby line text for each reference
Open the referenced script file in Obsidian and rescan saved files with Refresh
Filter scans to configured project folders (Pro)
Export a per-note reference report as a new Markdown note (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a backlinks or Fountain editing tool; it only scans [[>]] references in .fountain scripts and shows them in its own panel, without touching backlinks or the graph.
extras: Freemium: core features free, Pro (folder filters, reference report) requires a $5/month or one-time $15 GitHub Sponsors payment with device-flow sign-in that checks sponsorship. After updates it opens a promotional tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+; untested on mobile, with Fountain editor plugins, and on very large vaults.
problem: Obsidian's backlinks, search and graph do not see references written inside .fountain screenplay files, so character and location notes have no incoming links from scripts.

requires.name: a plugin that adds a view for .fountain files
GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Sidebar panel that lists incoming [[>target]] references from Fountain screenplay scripts to the active Markdown note.
